description:
Project Overview

Wageningen is recruiting a PhD researcher to study the economics of native-species production and rural development in Brazil’s Cerrado. The project focuses on livelihoods, biodiversity and value chains in the MATOPIBA region.

Research Position Overview

Combine household and farm surveys with geospatial information and econometric analysis. Investigate how native-species production relates to rural incomes and land-use decisions, working with the Forest and Nature Conservation Policy group.

Research Areas

  • Cerrado
  • Biodiversity economics
  • Rural development
  • Econometrics
